literal: Sloth destroying, conducting oneself, family as an exalted family, those who desire.
translation: Those who desire to elevate their family to an exalted status must live their lives by destroying laziness.
modern: தங்கள் குடும்பத்தை உயர்ந்த குடியாக உயர்த்த விரும்புகின்றவர்கள், சோம்பலை அழித்து வாழ வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the direct link between overcoming laziness and elevating one's family status. The author uses the word 'madi' twice in the first line with different meanings: first as a noun meaning 'sloth' (madiyai) and then as a verb meaning 'destroying' (madiyā). To make one's family a noble and prosperous one (kuṭiyāka), one must actively eliminate laziness from daily conduct (oḻukal). The verse teaches that family honor is not merely inherited but must be actively built and sustained through diligent effort.
